audit_items.proof_trace: For post-Fulu states, when requesting proposer index for epochs beyond [current, current+1] range, the function bypasses the pre-calculated lookahead and falls through to on-demand computation (lines 358-371), violating EIP-7951's requirement that all proposer queries use state.proposer_lookahead.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker triggers proposer index lookups for epoch = current+2 (or past epochs) via P2P block proposals or RPC calls, forcing expensive on-demand computation instead of O(1) lookahead access, enabling DoS through computational exhaustion and breaking the EIP-7951 performance guarantees.
